name: Garden of Earthly Delights
source:
A man needs to follow a trail in the desert that will lead him to the mythical and erotic Garden of Earthly Delights.
He has lost his memory and the only reference to his past is in the mysterious stones he was carrying.
He was found by Melody on the banks of a river completely naked, carrying only a bag of said stones.
What is this legendary paradise that the stones reveal?
What is his relationship with this paradise of carnal pleasures, watered with the most libidinous explicit sex?
translation:
一名男子必须沿着沙漠中的踪迹前行，去寻找传说中充满情欲色彩的“人间乐园”。
他失去了记忆，身上携带的神秘石块是通往过往的唯一线索。
梅洛迪在河岸边发现了他——当时的他浑身赤裸，身边只有一个装着那些石块的袋子。
石块所揭示的这座传奇乐园究竟是什么地方？
他又与这座由最放纵露骨的欢爱所浇灌的肉欲乐园有着怎样的渊源？
